integrity: Exact symbolic argument and independently executable standard-library Python exact checks; no external validation or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves all Fourier multipliers positive at odd positive orders, and only even-weight Fourier multipliers at even orders. No complete even-order inertia, no sharp spectral gap. The 1986 parity-restricted partition paper was checked via abstract, but full text was inaccessible.
title: Odd-order Fourier positivity for even-block membership in set partitions
